name: Vaporwave
about: The Vaporwave look, kept for good after its limited time (Ranyxia, 2026-11-23): a theme that is always there to pick on the Theme page once vaporwave__until-2026-12-02.json has passed (until then that one, with the same short name, stands in for it). Its buttons are the pictures in the vaporwave-ui folder, its banners the xifo_wave_*__theme-vaporwave pictures, its song "No Signal, All Vibes" by JØ.
